# env/.env.local

```dotenv
APP_TITLE_PREFIX=my-site-manual-tls

LISTENER_0_HOST=127.0.0.1
LISTENER_0_PORT=5443
LISTENER_0_SCHEME=https
LISTENER_0_TLS_SOURCE=manual
LISTENER_0_TLS_CERTIFICATE_FILE=./tls/fullchain.pem
LISTENER_0_TLS_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE=./tls/privkey.pem
```

This is the direct-app equivalent of the existing `examples/runtime-config/manual-tls.env` shape.
